relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: galcanezumab, an antibody binding calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) ligand

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment was associated with significant reductions from baseline in monthly migraine days and monthly headache days by 4.3 to 12.9 and 3.1 to 13.9, respectively.

key_findings: Real-world studies show galcanezumab significantly reduces monthly migraine and headache days, with effect within first month and sustained to 12 months.
